references.text: Moses tore down the tabernacle curtain after God expressed His displeasure, which can be seen as a precursor to the temple curtain being torn in two.
David speaks of the earth shaking and the mountains moving, resembling the description of an earthquake.
Jeremiah speaks of a broken heart, like the stones that were split apart.
The author of Hebrews refers to the curtain as a symbol of Christ's body, opening the way into the Most Holy Place.
The curtain as a picture of Jesus' body, which by His death opens a new and living way into God's presence.
